_comment: FLUX.1-schnell (GGUF Q5_K_S) text-to-image in ComfyUI API format. The worker fills the %PLACEHOLDERS% (src/worker/providers/comfy-images.ts). 4 steps, cfg 1 (schnell is distilled: no negative prompt), 768x1344 (9:16; ffmpeg scales to 1080x1920). The image comes back over the websocket (SaveImageWebsocket): nothing is saved on the server. The text encoders run on the CPU (device: cpu): FLUX (8 GB) and T5 (4.7 GB) don't fit together in the RTX 3060's 12 GB, and swapping them took ~136 s per image; with T5 on the CPU, FLUX stays on the GPU.
